info.title: ECHO (hand-authored) - Microservices
info.description: HAND-AUTHORED, not an EPA-published schema. Written 2026-11-02 from the behavior of the live service and from how the echo.epa.gov front end calls it. Only parameters that were exercised against the live service are listed; the service may accept or ignore others, and it can change without notice. Service micro_services. Both routes were verified with p_id. get_frs_id returns an empty or malformed JSON array (no closing bracket) when the id is not a program system ID, which breaks JSON parsing; pass a program system ID such as an ICIS-Air ID.

get.description: Maps a program system ID (for example an ICIS-Air ID such as OH0000000123010434) to the FRS registry ID. Returns FRSIds with PgmSysAcrnm, PgmSysId and RegistryId.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Output format. JSON (default), JSONP, or XML.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: JSONP callback. Name of the function in which to wrap the JSON response; used only with output=JSONP.

parameters.name: p_id
parameters.description: Program system ID, e.g. an ICIS-Air ID.
